phenomenon_scale.label: 37 µm
phenomenon_scale.structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Danio albolineatus (37 µm, detail scale)

governing_model.name: Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion
equations: du/dt = div(D_u grad u) + a - u + u^2 v
dv/dt = div(D_v grad v) + b - u^2 v
governing_model.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.boundary_conditions: periodic on an 8 by 5 wavelength flank patch
governing_model.negative_control: D_u = D_v (equal diffusion) is linearly stable; noise decays.

chronoseries_claim.scale_note: Comparisons are at the 37 µm cellular tier and age 0 Ma, not at the millimetre body-stripe scale.
chronoseries_claim.predecessor_danio_aesculapii: Inhibitor diffusivity is stretched along the anterior-posterior axis (alpha = 1.8) and compressed dorsoventrally. The dorsoventral mode is stable. The anterior-posterior mode is unstable at a longer wavelength and forms vertical bars.
chronoseries_claim.focal_danio_albolineatus: Isotropic diffusion at 1.22 times the critical inhibitor ratio. The fastest mode is tuned to 3.686e-05 m and its growth rate is several times smaller than either neighbour, so the flank remains a low-amplitude uniform interstripe.
chronoseries_claim.successor_danio_margaritatus: Activator diffusivity is reduced by 1.55 and the inhibitor ratio is raised to 2.40 times critical, which shortens the wavelength and places the kinetics in the spot regime.

empirical_claims.claim: Adjacent melanophores and xanthophores exclude one another, while melanophores require a more distant xanthophore population to differentiate and survive. That sign structure is the Turing condition.
Danio albolineatus does not recruit the dense early xanthophore population that reiterates zebrafish stripes, and its adult pattern is the uniform interstripe rather than a stack of stripes.
Danio colour patterns range from horizontal stripes to vertical bars to spots, and kcnj13 divergence between D. rerio and D. aesculapii changes melanophore shape and interactions.
Contact of a xanthophore dendrite transiently depolarizes a melanophore, a short-range interaction consistent with a cellular interaction length of tens of micrometres.

reported_in_source: Turing dispersion relation and critical wavenumber (Turing 1952).
Short-range melanophore-xanthophore exclusion and long-range melanophore dependence on xanthophores (Nakamasu et al. 2009).
D. albolineatus fails to build the reiterated zebrafish stripe stack (Patterson, Bain & Parichy 2014).
Vertical bars versus stripes versus spots across Danio, with kcnj13 implicated in the D. aesculapii bar pattern (Podobnik et al. 2020).
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg parameters (a, b) = (0.12, 0.88) and the diffusion ratios that place this species, its predecessor, and its successor on opposite sides of the spot/bar regimes.
The identification of the assigned 3.686e-05 m detail scale with lambda_c of the pearl-danio fastest mode.
Numerical integration on a periodic 96 by 60 grid.
transfer_boundary: Sister-species wavelengths are predictions of this diffusion change, not histological measurements at 37 µm.
One public-domain aquarium photograph is the specimen; it does not resolve a 37 µm mode (about 150 µm per pixel along the body).
does_not_claim: The sand, plants, and body outline are not produced by the reaction-diffusion equation.
The model is not Patterson & Parichy's cell-by-cell simulation and does not use their unpublished rate constants.
Equal-diffusion stability is a negative control, not a description of any Danio.
